'''Darke's Blessing''' is a [[special]] [[condition]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

It can only be put into play by an encounter at [[Darke's Carnival]].

==Card info==
'''Condition - Any Phase''': Any [[investigator]] may exhaust this card to re-roll a [[skill check]] that he or she has just failed.  This card refreshes at the start of each [[Upkeep phase]].
